title: BAF complexes maintain accessibility at stimulus-responsive chromatin and are required for transcriptional stimulus responses.
authors: Gulka, Alexander O D; Kang, Kihoon A; Zhou, Ziben; Gorkin, David U
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BAF染色质重塑复合物维持刺激响应性染色质可及性并影响转录因子结合，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但核心是染色质可及性调控，方法含机器学习预测，与TF-DNA结合建模课题部分相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Gene expression changes in response to developmental and environmental cues rely on cis-regulatory sequence elements (cREs). BRG1/BRM-Associated Factors (BAF) chromatin remodeling complexes maintain chromatin accessibility at many cREs, enabling binding by transcription factors (TFs). However, cREs exhibit a broad range of sensitivity to loss of BAF function, and the basis of this variability remains unknown. RESULTS: To identify the characteristics of BAF-dependent cREs, we mapped chromatin accessibility changes following acute pharmacologic BAF inhibition in GM12878 lymphoblastoid cells. We integrated these results with over 100 TF and histone modification ChIP-seq datasets and used machine learning to identify features that predict chromatin accessibility changes. We found that Activator Protein 1 (AP-1) factors and lymphoid lineage-defining TFs including RUNX3 and PU.1 predicted BAF-dependence. Strikingly, we found that cREs bearing the chromatin signature of "primed" enhancers - enriched for H3K4me1 but lacking H3K27ac - were significantly more sensitive to BAF inhibition than typical active enhancers. As primed enhancers are known to facilitate transcriptional responses to stimuli, we tested the requirement of BAF activity in these responses. Acute BAF inhibition was sufficient to prevent both chromatin and transcriptional responses to interferon gamma and dexamethasone. cREs which normally gained accessibility in response to stimulation failed to do so with BAF inhibition, and these cREs were linked to genes with suppressed transcriptional induction. CONCLUSIONS: Collectively, our results demonstrate a requirement for continuous BAF activity to enable stimulus response and suggest that defective signal responsiveness may be a pathogenic mechanism in disease states caused by loss-of-function mutations in BAF subunits.
abstract_zh: 背景：基因表达响应发育和环境信号的变化依赖于顺式调控序列元件（cREs）。BRG1/BRM相关因子（BAF）染色质重塑复合物在许多cREs处维持染色质可及性，从而促进转录因子（TFs）的结合。然而，cREs对BAF功能丧失的敏感性表现出广泛差异，而这种变异的基础仍不清楚。结果：为识别BAF依赖性cREs的特征，我们在GM12878淋巴母细胞中通过急性药理学BAF抑制绘制了染色质可及性变化图谱。我们将这些结果与超过100个TF和组蛋白修饰ChIP-seq数据集整合，并使用机器学习来预测染色质可及性变化的特征。我们发现激活蛋白1（AP-1）因子以及淋巴谱系定义性TFs（包括RUNX3和PU.1）可预测BAF依赖性。显著地，我们发现带有“预激活”增强子染色质特征（富集H3K4me1但缺乏H3K27ac）的cREs对BAF抑制的敏感性显著高于典型活性增强子。由于已知预激活增强子能促进对刺激的转录响应，我们测试了BAF活性在这些响应中的必要性。急性BAF抑制足以阻止对干扰素γ和地塞米松的染色质及转录响应。正常情况下在刺激下获得可及性的cREs在BAF抑制下未能如此，而这些cREs与转录诱导受抑制的基因相关联。结论：总体而言，我们的结果证明持续BAF活性是刺激响应所必需的，并提示信号响应缺陷可能是BAF亚基功能丧失突变所致疾病状态中的致病机制。
